original_benchmark.notes: Public evaluation release: 162 entries x 2 question variants. The paper's 352-task full set and training data are not released.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on a fixed 30-task split (5 per category), 3 runs per side: original 0.791 ± 0.017, Harbor 0.801 ± 0.005. Run ranges overlap overall and in every category. Standard agent check: codex@0.171.0 + gpt-6.1-sol scores 0.806 ± 0.009 on the same split (Harbor only).
